text.section:
The Board may also impose penalties on:
A person, firm, or entity that does not hold a Virginia license, or that does not meet the requirements to use the CPA title in Virginia under the practice privilege provisions of § 54.1-4411, and commits any of the acts prohibited by § 54.1-4414; or
A firm or entity that does not meet the criteria prescribed by subdivision D 1 of § 54.1-4412.1 and commits any of the acts prohibited by § 54.1-4414.
